title: Home Care Agency Business Suite: Excel & Google Sheets Templates
headline: Find the clients that lose money and see cash trouble 13 weeks ahead
description:
Run a non-medical home care agency from 8 workbooks for Excel and Google Sheets: quotes, schedule, visits, pay, invoices, hiring and cash. One payment of 29 dollars. No subscription, no macros.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
✓ Find the clients who earn less than your target margin, and the rate that fixes it
✓ Fill open shifts with the best-matched caregiver; see overtime before payroll
✓ Find hours paid to caregivers but never billed to clients
✓ Check every pay run line by line: overtime, travel, mileage
✓ Phone the right balances first; track every payer claim to payment
✓ See cash 13 weeks ahead and the largest owner draw above your cash floor

INSIDE: 8 WORKBOOKS, 632 PAGES
Enquiries, Quotes and Agreements · Schedule, Matching and Cover · Visits, Hours and Travel · Caregiver Payroll and Overtime · Client Invoices, Deposits and Payers · Recruiting, Onboarding and Renewals · Client Margin and Hours Growth · Owner Money and Business Health. 144 tools, 160 tables, 96 forms and 272 message texts. Each part: a blank workbook plus a sample-data copy.

FILE FORMAT
Standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice, plus "Make a copy" links for Google Sheets. Instructions on the first sheet, locked formula cells, currency symbol in one cell, dates in your regional format.

NOT FOR: live tracking, GPS check-in, a client portal, care notes or filing payer claims.

GUARANTEE: if a file does not work as described, we fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days.
experience_name: Download – Home Care Agency Business Suite
lesson_md:
## Download your 8 workbooks

1. Download the ZIP file below and unzip it. Each of the 8 folders holds a blank workbook and a copy with sample data.
2. Open a workbook in Microsoft Excel or LibreOffice, or use the Google Sheets links below ("Make a copy" saves your own copy to your Google Drive).
3. Start on the first sheet: it explains every page. Replace the sample rows with your own.
